title: Anybody else also dreaming of a museum/ exhibition space?
content: I literally felt nauseous when I found this sub as I've been baffled by my mall dreams for YEARS and have been Googling my experiences to no avail. The most prominent for me are a mall environment (definitely similar to Dubai Mall) and a grand theatre, which I dream about regularly. However, the most real/ vivid of the 'mall' dreams is an art museum/ exhibition space, which feels as if it's on the top floor of the structure, above the shopping areas. This space feels really grand, the room is dark, regal and feels generally unsettling. I had a string feeling that I shouldn't be there. Has anybody else experienced this? I also feel as if there was a large dome style roof.
